verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows LiveKit itself accepting natural-language commands to operate the platform, such as managing rooms, deployments or tokens. The nearby items are adjacent at best: the docs MCP and coding-agent skills help an external coding agent answer LiveKit questions, Agent Builder is about designing agents' prompts, and the CLI is command-driven. None of these is a first-party natural-language control interface for the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
